```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [epic, develop]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Enable corepack
        run: corepack enable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run Vitest
        run: pnpm test
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: vitest-results
          path: ./test-results.xml

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: Vitest
          path: ./test-results.xml
          reporter: jest-junit
          artifact: vitest-results

      - name: Notify code owners on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const { data: pull } = await github.rest.pulls.get({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: context.payload.pull_request.number
            });
            const owners = pull.requested_reviewers.map(r => r.login).concat(pull.requested_teams.map(t => t.slug));
            const body = `⚠️ Tests failed. Code owners ${owners.join(', ')} please review.`;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.payload.pull_request.number,
              body
            });
```
